integrity.proof_basis: Explicit modular matrix seed, exact uniform branch-distance lemma, finite seed residues and bijective lifting
integrity.scientific_claim: Exact image, minimal periods, fiber counts and 13-adic closure of Pell values modulo every 13-power

scientific_limitations: Specific to the prime 13; does not cover other Pell-Wieferich primes, other Lucas parameters, or absolute historical priority. An explicitly relevant 2023 publication on complete residue systems of balancing numbers could not be fully inspected. Finite computations do not prove infinite claims.
title: The exact \(13\)-adic residue spectrum and fiber multiplicities of Pell numbers
